purpose: Cross-rubric repeatability and human-quality sensitivity on the already-frozen HANNA v3 repeatability slice. No new human judgment is collected.

dataset.selection_rule: Use its deterministic one-development-item-per-model repeatability derivation unchanged: 11 items, 11 source-model groups, five repetitions per arm.
dataset.ratings_policy: Use only pinned, already-published HANNA three-rater annotations. External inputs and raw prose remain outside this repository and are never published.

provider.session_commitment_policy: Verify unique provider session IDs when source records attest them; otherwise report session uniqueness as unavailable and bind the accepted and rejected artifact-record commitments.
provider.network: Every remote dispatch requires the native --allow-remote CLI gate; immediately before each dispatch the runner discloses the exact relative path, bytes, and SHA-256 of the outbound story and originating prompt. Native arms additionally disclose the scoring-instruction and response-schema files and the exact rendered-prompt bytes and SHA-256.

stopping_rule: Run exactly five accepted fresh-session repetitions for every one of the 11 frozen samples and every arm. Resume only an identical checkpointed run; never add, drop, reorder based on, or selectively repeat samples after outputs exist.

arms.method: HBQ-RS prose.short_story binary leaves plus the frozen HANNA prompt-response goal, with deterministic aggregation

arms.native_scale: content and structure 0-16; style and accuracy 0-24; total 0-40

bootstrap.comparison: paired arm deltas on the same frozen sample and repetition

confidence_diagnostics.scope: HBQ leaves only; secondary and noncanonical
targets: historical prior slot keyed to the exact judge fingerprint
Brier, ECE, reliability bins, and selective retention against repeat consensus
confidence_diagnostics.repeat_consensus_policy: Repeat consensus is a calibration proxy, never human truth.
confidence_diagnostics.effective_confidence_mass_policy: Effective confidence mass is reported by name and must never be called coverage.
confidence_diagnostics.canonical_policy: Confidence diagnostics do not change canonical scores, coverage, penalties, or hard gates; penalties and hard gates remain separate role strata.

quality_sensitivity.primary: continuous tie-aware Spearman of each repeat score against HANNA human_overall
secondary: Spearman of the five-repeat mean against HANNA human_overall
per-repeat rank reliability against the other repeats
Kendall W with undefined constants reported as undefined
quality_sensitivity.band_policy: Bands are descriptive only because the fixed 11-item slice can have thin cells; no output may alter selection or cutpoints.

interpretation_limits: All arm outputs remain on their native scales; raw totals are never pooled or directly compared across rubrics.
This study describes a fixed, public human-rated HANNA slice, not a universal validity proof or new human assessment.
Repeatability and quality sensitivity are distinct: stable scores do not by themselves establish literary validity.
The two coarse anchors are included because their observed stability prompted the comparison, not as official scoring methods.
